Genius (Kiga is a master manipulator who has been pulling the strings of every event in the Academy Saga, not unlike her sister Makima's position in the Public Safety Saga. She developed multiple plans involving the manipulation of multiple people, devils, and pawns, to starve the War Devil and turn her into a pawn— and although this failed due to Chainsaw Man's interference, it did not faze her: she adapted to this issue and instead manipulated both Asa and Yoru into working for her of their own free will, promising them both their true wishes. At the same time, she had her subordinates manipulate DenjiChainsaw Man, Chapter 140 in preparation for the breaking of his contract with Pochita. Kiga founded and led as the brains of the Chainsaw Man Church,Chainsaw Man, Chapter 132 an organization which successfully gathered over 350,000 members across multiple nations. This sham church was in reality a method for the Fire Devil— incognito as the "Justice Devil"— to gain as many contractors as possible who would be transformed into hundreds of thousands of Chainsaw Man-like devils, thereby inspiring fear of both Chainsaw Man and War, all in order to empower Chainsaw Man and the War Devil so that they can be made capable of defeating the Death Devil. She continued to personally manipulate AsaChainsaw Man, Chapter 165 while using her underlings to manipulate Denji,Chainsaw Man, Chapter 170 finally successfully breaking Denji's contract with Pochita just as she had planned, unleashing an empowered Hero of Hell upon earthChainsaw Man, Chapter 171) Standard Tactics: Rather than engaging directly, Kiga tends to act from the shadows, having her pawns do the fighting for her while she schemes.

She cannot tell faces apart, be they human or devil, instead relying on scent for identification. She cannot turn those who are not "starved" into pawns. Her pawns have restrictions, and are weaker than before they were turned into pawns. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Starved Pawns: Kiga's primary power seems to be her ability to turn the starved into her pawns. These pawns are loyal to Kiga regardless of their strength, seen through her command over a Primal Fear, although some pawns such as Guillotine Devil have rebellious attitudes. Kiga claims that the devils summoned by her power have restrictions and are weak, making her try to avoid using them, although she does not wish to reveal these restrictions. Her pawns can also be turned into small, portable effigies, making them easy to transport. *Teleportation: Kiga has displayed the ability to teleport, vanishing with a snap of her fingers or appearing in a locked room without any sign of her presence beforehand. ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses: Inconclusive: ==Notes & References== Category:Characters Category:Female Characters Category:Chainsaw Man Category:Villains Category:Evil Characters Category:Primary Antagonists Category:Mind Users Category:Summoners Category:Teleportation Users Category:BFR Users Category:Transmutation Users Category:Demons Category:Healers Category:Statistics Amplification Users Category:Gravity Users Category:Time Users Category:Size Users Category:Fire Users Category:Danmaku Users Category:Immortals Category:Contract Users

Combat Genius. Teresa possessed extraordinary combat sense, swordsmanship, timing, and Yoki perception. Her ability to read the flow of Yoki allowed her to predict enemy movement with extreme accuracy. In her revived state, she could use Clare's accumulated experience to reproduce and surpass the techniques of other warriors.

Teresa lost her ruthlessness and showed excessive compassion for her opponents after she met and bonded with Clare. In the final battle, Teresa had only come back to the living world to answer Clare's call and wrap up her business there; once that was done, she would be gone for good. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Personal Skill: **Acute Yoki Sensing: Teresa's greatest specialty. She could sense the minute flow of Yoki inside an opponent's body and predict their next movements from it. This ability was so refined that, combined with her physical ability and swordsmanship, she could defeat most enemies without any visible change in fighting style. **Teresa of the Faint Smile: Teresa's title came from her habit of slaying enemies while wearing the same faint smile. Because she rarely needed to release Yoki and had no flashy signature style in ordinary combat, her calm expression became the most recognizable feature of her fighting. **Controlled Awakening: During the final battle, Teresa awakened under Clare's control. Because Clare acted as the anchor to Teresa's heart and humanity, Teresa was able to assume an awakened form without losing herself. In this state, she took on a form reminiscent of mythological twin goddesses and ended the battle with Priscilla. *Mimicry: Teresa can mimic techniques and abilities she and Clare have witnessed or learned. **Quicksword: Irene's signature technique and Clare's trump card. The technique releases Yoki into one arm to unleash extremely rapid sword strikes while the rest of the body remains controlled. Teresa brought out the technique's full potential, using it to shred many of Priscilla's bodies in less than a second. **Dust Eater: Cassandra's signature fighting style. It involves planting both feet firmly and swinging the head and upper body like a pendulum, using awkward low-angle movement and centrifugal force to attack from unexpected directions. Teresa saw through the technique despite its unusual nature. **Rafaela's Fighting Style: A combat style inherited by Clare through Rafaela's memories. It involves spreading a membrane of Yoki around the body to sense movements outside one's field of vision, while combining swordsmanship with kicks and other physical techniques. **Drill Sword: Jean's powerful drill-like attack, performed by twisting the arm at high speed to create a piercing rotational strike. **Rippling Sword: Ophelia's signature technique. It uses the flexibility of the user's arm and sword to make the blade undulate, creating a rippling illusion that makes the attack difficult to read. **Phantom Mirage: Miria's movement technique, which uses bursts of Yoki to create high-speed afterimages. Teresa's speed was so great that even casual movement could produce a similar phantom-like effect. **Windcutter: Flora's sword technique. It is a blindingly fast slashing technique based more on skill, timing, and sword-drawing speed than Yoki release. Though slower and less powerful than Quicksword, it is easier to control. Combat Genius. Teresa possessed extraordinary combat sense, swordsmanship, timing, and Yoki perception. Her ability to read the flow of Yoki allowed her to predict enemy movement with extreme accuracy. In her revived state, she could use Clare's accumulated experience to reproduce and surpass the techniques of other warriors.

Teresa lost her ruthlessness and showed excessive compassion for her opponents after she met and bonded with Clare. In the final battle, Teresa had only come back to the living world to answer Clare's call and wrap up her business there; once that was done, she would be gone for good. Notable Attacks/Techniques: *Personal Skill: **Acute Yoki Sensing: Teresa's greatest specialty. She could sense the minute flow of Yoki inside an opponent's body and predict their next movements from it. This ability was so refined that, combined with her physical ability and swordsmanship, she could defeat most enemies without any visible change in fighting style. **Teresa of the Faint Smile: Teresa's title came from her habit of slaying enemies while wearing the same faint smile. Because she rarely needed to release Yoki and had no flashy signature style in ordinary combat, her calm expression became the most recognizable feature of her fighting. **Controlled Awakening: During the final battle, Teresa awakened under Clare's control. Because Clare acted as the anchor to Teresa's heart and humanity, Teresa was able to assume an awakened form without losing herself. In this state, she took on a form reminiscent of mythological twin goddesses and ended the battle with Priscilla. *Mimicry: Teresa can mimic techniques and abilities she and Clare have witnessed or learned. **Quicksword: Irene's signature technique and Clare's trump card. The technique releases Yoki into one arm to unleash extremely rapid sword strikes while the rest of the body remains controlled. Teresa brought out the technique's full potential, using it to shred many of Priscilla's bodies in less than a second. **Dust Eater: Cassandra's signature fighting style. It involves planting both feet firmly and swinging the head and upper body like a pendulum, using awkward low-angle movement and centrifugal force to attack from unexpected directions. Teresa saw through the technique despite its unusual nature. **Rafaela's Fighting Style: A combat style inherited by Clare through Rafaela's memories. It involves spreading a membrane of Yoki around the body to sense movements outside one's field of vision, while combining swordsmanship with kicks and other physical techniques. **Drill Sword: Jean's powerful drill-like attack, performed by twisting the arm at high speed to create a piercing rotational strike. **Rippling Sword: Ophelia's signature technique. It uses the flexibility of the user's arm and sword to make the blade undulate, creating a rippling illusion that makes the attack difficult to read. **Phantom Mirage: Miria's movement technique, which uses bursts of Yoki to create high-speed afterimages. Teresa's speed was so great that even casual movement could produce a similar phantom-like effect. **Windcutter: Flora's sword technique. It is a blindingly fast slashing technique based more on skill, timing, and sword-drawing speed than Yoki release. Though slower and less powerful than Quicksword, it is easier to control. Teresa used it together with Helen's limb extension to greatly increase the reach of her slashes. ==Gallery== Teresa1.png Teresa.jpg ==Notable Matchups== Victories: Losses: Inconclusive: Category:Characters Category:Claymore Category:Female Characters Category:Chi Users Category:Immortals Category:Shapeshifters Category:Antiheroes Category:Hybrids Category:Humans Category:Demons Category:Anime Characters Category:Manga Characters Category:Sword Users Category:Regeneration Users Category:Statistics Amplification Users Category:Weapon Masters Category:Power Mimicry Users Category:Afterimage Users Category:Social Influencers Category:Precognition Users

Firstly, he is able to determine the strength of anyone at a glance, such as when he discerned that Kyojuro was a Hashira just by looking at him. Secondly, Akaza is able to detect the presence of his opponents in his immediate surroundings (even in his blind spots) and can use this to predict where and how his opponents will strike him. This technique also allows Akaza to tell where his target's weaknesses are located and instinctively aim for them. Furthermore, the precision of Akaza's attacks are greatly enhanced, to the point where Tanjiro stated that it was like magnets were pulling his fists towards his vitals, and even described them as having "unparalleled precision". This is hinted at when a slight scrape from his kick (even while his sword had blocked it) caused Tanjiro to bleed. Moreover, Tanjiro also stated that Akaza was able to pierce through any opening in his attacks without fail. Another trait of his Compass Needle allows him to reactively adapt to his opponent's attacks, learning to anticipate their techniques and attack forms and even strike back with equal accuracy over time. Additionally, the stronger a person's Battle Spirit, the stronger the response of his Compass Needle. His Battle Spirit detection is so accurate that he can find the location of Tanjiro in his surroundings and fight and overpower Giyu without a head, meaning that he is performing those feats while basically being deaf and blind. *: Akaza punches the empty air in front him, creating a shockwave that flies towards his enemies and hits them from afar. This technique was strong enough to go through Kyojuro's most powerful attack, Rengoku. *: . **: A reverse, rising axe kick that produces a shockwave once it connects with the target. **: A flashing flurry of powerful straight kicks so fast that they create afterimages, with each kick producing powerful shockwaves. This technique was powerful enough to launch Giyu an extremely far distance. **: A kick that utilizes a flowing motion which strikes Akaza's target from below and launches them upward. *: Akaza unleashes eight powerful punches, each strike creating large and strong shockwaves in a similar fashion to his Disorder technique. *: . **: A powerful downward punch that delivers a large shockwave into the ground which expands outward. *: Akaza's ultimate technique. Akaza unleashes an omni-directional barrage of countless thin and sharp shockwaves that deliver a hundred blows to his target coming from everywhere almost at the same time. In another instance, when he left Kanao and Inosuke to fight his ice clones, he construed that Inosuke had an acute sense of touch just by observing his behavior when near his ice techniques. It is also implied that Doma was able to trick and deceive all of his followers, allowing him to kill and eat them. He was able to keep this up for over a century with almost complete infallibility. Doma also possesses incredible memory, being able to remember even the most insignificant details from back when he was human, which was over a century ago)

So if her Share Energy were to be drained (or her connection is cut off) then her transformation will be canceled out. She also hates Eggplants to an astounding degree where one time when she was being attacked by flying eggplants, she immediately stopped her transformation and ran away. forms.name: The ugliness of having my head cut off, my body diced and crushed into pieces, and being unwilling to accept defeat. A disgrace to life. Is this why I lived for hundreds of years? Did I really not want to die? So much that I turned into a hideous monster? Did I really want to be stronger? So much that I ate all those humans? Did I really not want to die? To the point I became this wretched creature? No. I... I just... Yoriichi. I just wanted to be like you.
Kokushibō}} is the secondary antagonist of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba. He was a demon affiliated with the Twelve Kizuki, holding the highest position, {{Nihongo

Jōgen no Ichi}}. As a Kizuki, Kokushibo is one of the closest servants of the King of Demons, Muzan Kibutsuji, whose main purpose is to find the Blue Spider Lily so that Muzan can gain immunity from the sun. Nearly five centuries ago during the Sengoku Era (the Golden Age of Demon Slayers), Kokushibo was a human by the name of {{Nihongo

Tsugikuni Michikatsu}}, a former Demon Slayer and the older twin brother of Yoriichi Tsugikuni, the strongest Demon Slayer that ever existed. Kokushibo is also the ancestor of Muichiro Tokito and Yuichiro Tokito and the one responsible for turning Zenitsu Agatsuma's senior, Kaigaku, into a demon and joining the Twelve Kizuki. == Powers and Stats

attack_potency.text: At least Town level, likely far higher (As the holder of the Upper Rank 1 position, he is the strongest of the Twelve Kizuki, and is second only to Muzan in the hierarchy, making him far superior to the likes of Gyutaro, who demolished the entire Entertainment District with his Blood Blades. Stated by Doma to be superior to Akaza and has defeated and absorbed three other demons who challenged his rank before. Easily defeated Marked Muichiro, severing his arm in a single swipe before pinning him to a column using his own Nichirin Sword. Kept up with Sanemi in multiple clashes, ultimately overwhelming him and leaving his torso slashed open, requiring stitches. Kept up with Gyomei and forced him to activate his Demon Slayer Mark. Stood his ground against Marked Gyomei and Sanemi together without resorting to using his Shichishito Blade and has cut the latter's fingers off, and would have slashed both of his arms off if Gyomei didn't intervene and divert the attack. Slashed Marked Muichiro and Demon-Transformed Genya in half, while pushing Gyomei and Sanemi away, and freeing himself from Genya's paralyzing Blood Demon Art>6.45 Kilotons of TNT), possibly higher in Monster Form

speed.text: At least Massively Hypersonic+, likely far higher (Blitzed base Akaza and slashed off his arm without him noticing. Blitzed Marked Muichiro, slashing his arm off in a single swipe and pinning him to a pillar column before he can even react, with Muichiro considering the speed to be "in another dimension" compared to his own, which should make him faster than Hashira like Mitsuri who dodged lightning and Tengen who could cut numerous bombs at once before they even explode.> Mach 2274), higher attack speed with Shichishito Blade Form (Blitzed Marked Sanemi and Marked Gyomei from far away, with both of them crediting his speed, and Sanemi admitting he would've lost his arms if not for Gyomei diverting the attack and has kept both them whom were Marked at bay, with them only being able to get close due to Genya's Blood Demon Art restraining him), even higher with Monster Form (Completely blitzed both Marked Sanemi and Gyomei.)

lifting_strength.text: At least Class K (Should be physically comparable, if not superior to Marked Gyomei. Capable of swinging a flesh sword that is significantly larger than his own body at incredibly high speeds. striking_strength.text: At least Town level, likely higher (Comparable to his AP)

speed.text: Supersonic+ (Can keep up with Hairo, who should be inferior to Enmu, but comparable to Rui who as a member of the Twelve Kizuki should be significantly faster than the lesser Slasher Demon who could run across an entire railroad track in seconds.)

durability.text: Building level (Survived being at the epicenter of an explosion that destroyed the roof of a building.)

stamina.text: Superhuman (Hashira can train for several months on end. Superior to Tanjiro who endured extremely taxing training for seven days non-stop with no food, no sleep, and only a small amount of water from rain, later drained for even greater stamina, was also getting injured frequently during the training session. Far superior to Inosuke who can hunt for three days. Comparable to fellow Hashira who fought Lower Rank-level demons in the Dimensional Infinity Fortress for nearly 5 hours on top of fighting Upper Ranks. In his Special One-Shot, Kyojuro ruptured his eardrums, yet didn't flinch in the slightest, ignoring the pain and continuing to fight and win. In Kyojuro Rengoku's Story, he suffered dozens of severe wounds and injuries from gunshots and explosions coming from the former Lower Rank 2, Hairo, but continued to stall enough time for all the bombs he planted to be disarmed without showing any signs of pain or fatigue, which shocked Hairo, who questioned himself on whether the person he met in the past was really the same person he was fighting now. Furthermore, his battle against Enmu when he fused with an entire train, he was able to keep him at bay in 5 different train carts without tiring. Lastly, he managed to keep up with Akaza, one of the strongest demons in existence despite physically and mentally exert himself beyond his limit and sustaining multiple irreparable and fatal wounds, like a smashed eye, shattered ribs and damaged internal organs. Most impressively, he managed to keep Akaza at bay despite having his vital spot, his Solar Plexus, pierced by the Upper Rank's arm and bleeding out. Despite all of his fatal wounds and injuries, he never once flinched or showed signs of pain or agony)

intelligence.text: Gifted (As a swordsman who came from a lineage of Flame Hashira, Kyojuro had access to generations of combat knowledge and tactics as well as training from previous Flame Hashira, like his father, Shinjuro Rengoku. Kyojuro could also master the entire Breath of Flames style just from reading 3 volumes of a book on it. During the battle against Akaza, he displayed keen judgement like after being attacked by Akaza's Destructive Death: Air Type, he realizes that he must fight at close range with he wanted to increase the chances of cutting of his head. Even when the usually deductive and sagacious Tanjiro Kamado was at a loss of how to kill Enmu, Kyojuro instinctively knew that, no matter what form a demon takes, it will always have a weak spot. He also possesses great knowledge in the use of the Total Concentration Breathing, knowing how to plug minor wounds and hemorrhaging and saved Tanjiro from dying of blood loss. As another testament to his tactical intellect, Kyojuro could instantly read his allies' sign language at indicating the Flute Demon's abilities despite being unable to fully control their movements and execute a countermeasure before the demon's Blood Demon Art befell him)

Town level (Superior to Post-Type Zero training Tanjiro, as Tanjiro hadn't reached the level of a Hashira until after his Hashira training, who could match Hantengu's emotion clones. Should be comparable to the other Hashira, as he is a prodigy who reached the Hashira rank within two months after picking up a sword, earning him the praise of Tengen. Matched Obanai and Sanemi in a sparring match with wooden swords during the Hashira Training Arc), higher with Demon Slayer Mark (Should be comparable to Marked Mitsuri Kanroji who could compete with Upper Moon 4 level demons. Massively Hypersonic+ (Should be comparable to other Hashira such as Unmarked Mitsuri who could dodge lightning and Tengen who could do this. Outsped Sanemi and Obanai in a 1 Vs 2), far higher with the Demon Slayer Mark (Casually cut through Gyokko's attack "Ten Thousand Gliding Clayfish", and casually blitzed Gyokko himself), far higher with Transparent World (Dodged many of Kokushibo's serious attacks which blitzed him in his casual state and even landed a hit on him), even higher with Death Amp
Town level (Should be comparable to Mitsuri, Tengen and Rengoku), higher with the Demon Slayer Mark (Should be comparable to Marked Mitsuri)

Superhuman (Went through training so intense that it made him cough blood and put him on the verge of death. Comparable to Gyomei Himejima and Sanemi Shinazugawa who fought Lower Rank-level Demons in the Infinity Castle for nearly 5 hours on top of fighting Upper Rank 1, Kokushibo. Demons quickly disintegrate into dust when exposed to sunlight, and despite their regeneration, will die upon decapitation from a Nichirin Blade due to their sun absorbing materials, Hantengu's emotion clones, however, can't be killed via Nichirin decapitation and can only be killed via sunlight or when Hantengu's main body is decapitated for the second time. Wisteria is poisonous to demons. His emotion clones weaken when splitting further after they're all manifested. Damaging his or his clones' tongues make them regenerate slower. Sekido's lightning is unable to pass through the flesh of his fellow emotion clones or Hantengu himself due to them being of the same flesh. Notable Attacks/Techniques: HantenguSplit.gif|Hantengu splitting to manifest Sekido and Karaku *: **Emotional Demon Clone Manifestation: Hantengu's Blood Demon Art allows him to manifest his emotions as younger clones of himself, which can be identified by a kanji on their tongue. These clones all have different appearances, abilities, and weapons, with their individual strength being at least Upper Rank caliber. The emotions shown are anger, pleasure, sorrow, joy, hatred, and resentment, with Hantengu himself having the kanji of "fear" etched onto his tongue. SekidoLightning.gif|Sekido electrocuting Tanjiro with his Khakkhara *: **Lightning Generation: Sekido's Blood Demon Art allows him to generate lightning that flashes blue and red from his Khakkhara by stabbing it onto a surface, typically the ground. His lightning was extremely potent, instantly paralyzing targets, even if they are in mid-air, and causing them to lose consciousness in a short period of time. KarakuWindBlast.gif|Karaku launching away Muichiro with his Uchiwa *: **Wind Blasts: Karaku's Blood Demon Art allows him to generate powerful, green gusts of wind by swinging down his maple leaf-shaped Uchiwa. UrogiSonicScream.gif|Urogi attacking Tanjiro with his Sonic Scream *: **Sonic Scream: Urogi's Blood Demon Art allows him to generate powerful, yellow sound waves from his mouth, by inhaling amounts of air that glows bright yellow light from his mouth. SekidoWeepingSpears.gif|Aizetsu putting multiple holes through Genya with Weeping Spears *: **Spear Projection: Aizetsu's Blood Demon Art allows him to create multiple jagged blue-to-red projectiles out of thin air by simply thrusting his Yari and instantly launch them at his targets from afar. ***: Aizetsu thrusts his Yari, creating multiple long-ranged projections of the spear attack. ZohakutenCrazedCryofThunderDeath.gif|Zohakuten's Crazed Cry of Thunderdeath ZohakutenCountlessStrikingTrees.gif|Zohakuten's Countless Striking Trees ZohakutenCompressedSoundWaves.gif|Zohakuten attacking Mitsuri with Compressed Sound Waves *: **Wood Manipulation: Zohakuten's main Blood Demon Art grants him the ability to take control of the trunks of surrounding trees and manipulate it by striking the drums at his back. Zohakuten mainly shapes the wood into massive snake-like dragon heads that can stretch up to twenty meters in length, though he can also create dragon heads within the main dragon heads in order to increase its length and reach. ***: Zohakuten strikes a drum, commanding two wooden dragons to unleash Sekido's electricity and Urogi's sound waves respectively. ***: Zohakuten incessantly strikes his drums, unleashing numerous wooden dragons to create a wide-ranged attack. ***: Zohakuten opens his mouth and unleashes extremely loud and powerful sound waves. Its use takes some concentration, which is aided by Cell putting his index and middle fingers to his foreheads, and he needs a ki signature to teleport to, otherwise he cannot perform the technique. It can be used to teleport others as well, as long as they are in physical contact with Cell. *Spirit Bomb: Goku's ultimate attack, taught to him by King Kai, and which Cell claims to know how to be able to perform due to possessing Goku's DNA. It is utilized by gathering a vast amount of energy from all the lifeforms in his surroundings to create a massive, incredibly destructive sphere of ki. While one must have a pure heart to utilize it, it is possible that Cell is able to use it due to being pure evil, if he is even capable of using it at all. While it is incredibly powerful and can prove capable of completely destroying an opponent when used with sufficient power, it takes a very long time to charge and is therefore very difficult to use, though the charge time can be sped up by gathering energy from those who willingly and knowingly provide it. Notable Attacks and Techniques: Ki: The martial artist's fighting power and life force, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in several ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to dramatically increase strength. It can also be fired as blasts of energy or create defensive barriers. Frieza is a mighty mutant hybrid of his race with such ridiculous strength at birth that few could match him. He had to develop lesser, weaker forms to restrain his strength to better control his power. He is incredibly skilled in using ki, though his ignorance of its spiritual side meant he didn't know how to sense ki at first. *Death Ball: After gathering ki in the shape of a sphere with a single fingertip, Frieza creates a giant energy sphere that can easily destroy planets. His expertise in the technique allows him to restrain it to instead put a planet on a timer towards destruction if he so pleases. Its most powerful variant is the Supernova, a massive, sun-like sphere of energy that takes some time to charge but has immense power. Golden Frieza upgrades this technique into the even more powerful Golden Death Ball. *Death Beam: Frieza's favored finishing technique, a small, highly concentrated beam of ki fired from the fingertip with enough force to easily punch through an opponent's body. Frieza often uses this technique to torture his opponents before finishing them off and uses it with great precision. He can fire many of them rapidly, overwhelming his opponents with a barrage of high-power attacks. After his mental training in Hell, Frieza gained such control over his ki that his Death Beams could home in on opponents. *Death Psycho Bomb: By launching a small, invisible sphere of ki into his opponent, Frieza can force them to rise into the air as the sphere expands within them, ultimately exploding and destroying them from the inside. *Death Saucer: A technique similar to Krillin's Kienzan, though Frieza can make two of these discs at once and throw them at opponents. They home in on targets, making them difficult to escape. Still, Frieza's overconfidence makes it possible to lose track of them and cut himself in half by accident. It should be noted that it can cut through opponents several times stronger and more durable. *Death Wave: Frieza can gather ki in his fingertips before releasing it with a sweep of his arm, slicing through his surroundings with a thin, razor-sharp blade of energy. *Imprisonment Ball: Frieza can trap his opponent within a sphere of ki, preventing them from escaping, and while they're trapped within, he can toy with them, kicking them around like a ball before ultimately kicking them into the ground, causing a massive explosion. This explosion is so powerful that it creates a vacuum, sucking everything nearby to its center. *Nova Strike: After surrounding himself in a sphere of ki, Frieza launches himself at his opponent and slams into them with devastating force. ==Notes== Both the Manga and Anime of Dragon Ball are canon, however, Toei Animation has its own continuity of Dragon Ball and, therefore, what is in the Anime does not apply to the main canon which is the Manga, with the Anime having different scales and tiers than the Manga. An example of this is that in the Manga the strongest Majin Buu is indisputably Super Buu with Gohan absorbed, while in the Anime it is repeatedly said to be Kid Buu. This profile is made based exclusively on information from the original Manga only. To see the anime version click here. Frieza's Power level: Fake Power levels have made it a rule that Frieza's forms double his power. Although in the manga he says that he gets stronger with each transformation, only in his second form does he mention that surpass 1 million, which implies that he doubled his first form which has 530,000 Power level, which is collaborated by El Manga Legendary. However, when transforming into his third and fourth form, Frieza does not say any specific multiplier. But, considering that his transformations serve to contain his 100% which is 120,000,000 Power level, this means that in his fourth form and with 1% he would only have 1,200,000 Power level. *Correct power levels: With that out of the way, his mathematically correct power levels are: 530,000 (First Form); 1,060,000 (Second Form); 1,130,000 (Third Form) and 1,200,000 (Fourth form 1%). Notable Attacks and Techniques: Ki: The martial artist's fighting power and life force, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in several ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to dramatically increase strength. It can also be fired as blasts of energy or create defensive barriers. Frieza is a mighty mutant hybrid of his race with such ridiculous strength at birth that few could match him. He had to develop lesser, weaker forms to restrain his strength to better control his power. He is incredibly skilled in using ki, though his ignorance of its spiritual side meant he didn't know how to sense ki at first. *Death Ball: After gathering ki in the shape of a sphere with a single fingertip, Frieza creates a giant energy sphere that can easily destroy planets. His expertise in the technique allows him to restrain it to instead put a planet on a timer towards destruction if he so pleases. Its most powerful variant is the Supernova, a massive, sun-like sphere of energy that takes some time to charge but has immense power. Golden Frieza upgrades this technique into the even more powerful Golden Death Ball. *Death Beam: Frieza's favored finishing technique, a small, highly concentrated beam of ki fired from the fingertip with enough force to easily punch through an opponent's body. Frieza often uses this technique to torture his opponents before finishing them off and uses it with great precision. He can fire many of them rapidly, overwhelming his opponents with a barrage of high-power attacks. After his mental training in Hell, Frieza gained such control over his ki that his Death Beams could home in on opponents. *Death Psycho Bomb: By launching a small, invisible sphere of ki into his opponent, Frieza can force them to rise into the air as the sphere expands within them, ultimately exploding and destroying them from the inside. *Death Saucer: A technique similar to Krillin's Kienzan, though Frieza can make two of these discs at once and throw them at opponents. They home in on targets, making them difficult to escape. Still, Frieza's overconfidence makes it possible to lose track of them and cut himself in half by accident. It should be noted that it can cut through opponents several times stronger and more durable. *Death Wave: Frieza can gather ki in his fingertips before releasing it with a sweep of his arm, slicing through his surroundings with a thin, razor-sharp blade of energy. *Imprisonment Ball: Frieza can trap his opponent within a sphere of ki, preventing them from escaping, and while they're trapped within, he can toy with them, kicking them around like a ball before ultimately kicking them into the ground, causing a massive explosion. An example of this is that in the Manga the strongest Majin Buu is indisputably Super Buu with Gohan absorbed, while in the Anime it is repeatedly said to be Kid Buu. Frieza's ki rapidly drains in his 100% power state due to his lack of experience with it, and he cannot fight for long in this condition. Notable Attacks and Techniques: Ki: The martial artist's fighting power and life force, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in several ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to dramatically increase strength. It can also be fired as blasts of energy or create defensive barriers. Frieza is a mighty mutant hybrid of his race with such ridiculous strength at birth that few could match him. He had to develop lesser, weaker forms to restrain his strength to better control his power. He is incredibly skilled in using ki, though his ignorance of its spiritual side meant he didn't know how to sense ki at first. *Death Ball: After gathering ki in the shape of a sphere with a single fingertip, Frieza creates a giant energy sphere that can easily destroy planets. His expertise in the technique allows him to restrain it to instead put a planet on a timer towards destruction if he so pleases. Its most powerful variant is the Supernova, a massive, sun-like sphere of energy that takes some time to charge but has immense power. Golden Frieza upgrades this technique into the even more powerful Golden Death Ball. *Death Beam: Frieza's favored finishing technique, a small, highly concentrated beam of ki fired from the fingertip with enough force to easily punch through an opponent's body. Frieza often uses this technique to torture his opponents before finishing them off and uses it with great precision. He can fire many of them rapidly, overwhelming his opponents with a barrage of high-power attacks. After his mental training in Hell, Frieza gained such control over his ki that his Death Beams could home in on opponents. *Death Psycho Bomb: By launching a small, invisible sphere of ki into his opponent, Frieza can force them to rise into the air as the sphere expands within them, ultimately exploding and destroying them from the inside. *Death Saucer: A technique similar to Krillin's Kienzan, though Frieza can make two of these discs at once and throw them at opponents. They home in on targets, making them difficult to escape. Still, Frieza's overconfidence makes it possible to lose track of them and cut himself in half by accident. It should be noted that it can cut through opponents several times stronger and more durable. *Death Wave: Frieza can gather ki in his fingertips before releasing it with a sweep of his arm, slicing through his surroundings with a thin, razor-sharp blade of energy. *Imprisonment Ball: Frieza can trap his opponent within a sphere of ki, preventing them from escaping, and while they're trapped within, he can toy with them, kicking them around like a ball before ultimately kicking them into the ground, causing a massive explosion. This explosion is so powerful that it creates a vacuum, sucking everything nearby to its center. *Nova Strike: After surrounding himself in a sphere of ki, Frieza launches himself at his opponent and slams into them with devastating force. ==Notes== Both the Manga and Anime of Dragon Ball are canon, however, Toei Animation has its own continuity of Dragon Ball and, therefore, what is in the Anime does not apply to the main canon which is the Manga, with the Anime having different scales and tiers than the Manga. Frieza is arrogant and sadistic, preferring to prolong an opponent's suffering rather than killing them right away, even when it is entirely feasible for him to do so. Frieza's ki rapidly drains in his 100% power state due to his lack of experience with it, and he cannot fight for long in this condition. Notable Attacks and Techniques: Ki: The martial artist's fighting power and life force, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in several ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to dramatically increase strength. It can also be fired as blasts of energy or create defensive barriers. Frieza is a mighty mutant hybrid of his race with such ridiculous strength at birth that few could match him. He had to develop lesser, weaker forms to restrain his strength to better control his power. He is incredibly skilled in using ki, though his ignorance of its spiritual side meant he didn't know how to sense ki at first. *Death Ball: After gathering ki in the shape of a sphere with a single fingertip, Frieza creates a giant energy sphere that can easily destroy planets. His expertise in the technique allows him to restrain it to instead put a planet on a timer towards destruction if he so pleases. Its most powerful variant is the Supernova, a massive, sun-like sphere of energy that takes some time to charge but has immense power. Golden Frieza upgrades this technique into the even more powerful Golden Death Ball. *Death Beam: Frieza's favored finishing technique, a small, highly concentrated beam of ki fired from the fingertip with enough force to easily punch through an opponent's body. Frieza often uses this technique to torture his opponents before finishing them off and uses it with great precision. He can fire many of them rapidly, overwhelming his opponents with a barrage of high-power attacks. After his mental training in Hell, Frieza gained such control over his ki that his Death Beams could home in on opponents. *Death Psycho Bomb: By launching a small, invisible sphere of ki into his opponent, Frieza can force them to rise into the air as the sphere expands within them, ultimately exploding and destroying them from the inside. *Death Saucer: A technique similar to Krillin's Kienzan, though Frieza can make two of these discs at once and throw them at opponents. They home in on targets, making them difficult to escape. Still, Frieza's overconfidence makes it possible to lose track of them and cut himself in half by accident. It should be noted that it can cut through opponents several times stronger and more durable. *Death Wave: Frieza can gather ki in his fingertips before releasing it with a sweep of his arm, slicing through his surroundings with a thin, razor-sharp blade of energy. *Imprisonment Ball: Frieza can trap his opponent within a sphere of ki, preventing them from escaping, and while they're trapped within, he can toy with them, kicking them around like a ball before ultimately kicking them into the ground, causing a massive explosion. This explosion is so powerful that it creates a vacuum, sucking everything nearby to its center. *Nova Strike: After surrounding himself in a sphere of ki, Frieza launches himself at his opponent and slams into them with devastating force. ==Notes== Both the Manga and Anime of Dragon Ball are canon, however, Toei Animation has its own continuity of Dragon Ball and, therefore, what is in the Anime does not apply to the main canon which is the Manga, with the Anime having different scales and tiers than the Manga. An example of this is that in the Manga the strongest Majin Buu is indisputably Super Buu with Gohan absorbed, while in the Anime it is repeatedly said to be Kid Buu. This profile is made based exclusively on information from the original Manga only. To see the anime version click here. Gohan has an explosive temper that can flare up suddenly and cause him to act irrationally, but besides this, he is typically a pacifist who avoids fighting and dislikes killing opponents. Due to this, he often keeps his true power restrained so as to avoid harming others. As a Super Saiyan 2 and after first getting his potential unlocked, Gohan was prone to overconfidence, even dipping into sadism during his battle with Cell and seeking to prolong his suffering as retaliation for his crimes. Needs a moon in order to transform and loses control of himself as an Oozaru and as he never trained the weakness away, his tail is a vulnerable point and grabbing or removing it will cause him intense pain. | None Notable (By the ToP he has since lost his Overconfidence and has a handle on his rage) Notable Attacks/Techniques: Ki: The fighting power and life force of a martial artist, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in a number of ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to greatly increase in strength, and it can be fired as blasts of energy or used to create defensive barriers. Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Gohan's incredible power and abilities. Even as a child, Gohan possessed an exceptionally high dormant potential that allows him to show the true depths of his power whenever his rage shows through and grow in strength quickly. Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further and further in power. *Masenko: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both of his hands above his head with his palms facing towards his opponents, he fires a powerful blast of ki. By charging it longer, he can also throw it as an explosive sphere of energy. *Kamehameha: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to finally destroy Cell. *Kiai: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. Saiyan Physiology: The physiology of a Saiyan, an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. One of the most powerful abilities of a Saiyan is their ability to grow stronger and stronger through combat, allowing Gohan to constantly push his own limits during a fight and rise to higher and higher peaks in power. This ability grants a substantial boost in power when Gohan is badly injured, allowing him to reach a whole new level of power once he recovers. *Oozaru: When exposed to the light of the full moon, as long as he still has his tail, Gohan will undergo a transformation into the Oozaru, a massive, gigantic monkey with far greater power. However, this comes at the expense of his skill, turning him into a violent, mindless monster who cannot differentiate between friend and foe. *Super Saiyan: The famous, legendary transformation of a Saiyan that allows them to greatly surpass their limits and reach the fabled state that is Super Saiyan. Gohan achieved this state during his training with his father in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Potential Unleashed: The ultimate form that Gohan gains after having his potential unlocked by Old Kai's lengthy ritual, greatly increasing his power by unlocking his extremely high dormant strength. While this state must be maintained by steady, regular training, while Gohan has access to it, he can tap into its power by powering up just as he would to go Super Saiyan. Its power eclipses that of his Super Saiyan forms by a significant margin, and in this state, Gohan is often known as Mystic Gohan or Ultimate Gohan. Gohan has an explosive temper that can flare up suddenly and cause him to act irrationally, but besides this, he is typically a pacifist who avoids fighting and dislikes killing opponents. Due to this, he often keeps his true power restrained so as to avoid harming others. As a Super Saiyan 2 and after first getting his potential unlocked, Gohan was prone to overconfidence, even dipping into sadism during his battle with Cell and seeking to prolong his suffering as retaliation for his crimes. Needs a moon in order to transform and loses control of himself as an Oozaru and as he never trained the weakness away, his tail is a vulnerable point and grabbing or removing it will cause him intense pain. | None Notable (By the ToP he has since lost his Overconfidence and has a handle on his rage) Notable Attacks/Techniques: Ki: The fighting power and life force of a martial artist, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in a number of ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to greatly increase in strength, and it can be fired as blasts of energy or used to create defensive barriers. Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Gohan's incredible power and abilities. Even as a child, Gohan possessed an exceptionally high dormant potential that allows him to show the true depths of his power whenever his rage shows through and grow in strength quickly. Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further and further in power. *Masenko: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both of his hands above his head with his palms facing towards his opponents, he fires a powerful blast of ki. By charging it longer, he can also throw it as an explosive sphere of energy. *Kamehameha: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to finally destroy Cell. *Kiai: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. Saiyan Physiology: The physiology of a Saiyan, an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. One of the most powerful abilities of a Saiyan is their ability to grow stronger and stronger through combat, allowing Gohan to constantly push his own limits during a fight and rise to higher and higher peaks in power. This ability grants a substantial boost in power when Gohan is badly injured, allowing him to reach a whole new level of power once he recovers. *Oozaru: When exposed to the light of the full moon, as long as he still has his tail, Gohan will undergo a transformation into the Oozaru, a massive, gigantic monkey with far greater power. However, this comes at the expense of his skill, turning him into a violent, mindless monster who cannot differentiate between friend and foe. *Super Saiyan: The famous, legendary transformation of a Saiyan that allows them to greatly surpass their limits and reach the fabled state that is Super Saiyan. Gohan achieved this state during his training with his father in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. These transformations can be reached through extensive training, but are more often unlocked in moments of intense emotional turmoil and need, and due to the natural aggressiveness of Saiyans, they cause the user to become more aggressive and malicious, and though Gohan has managed to make these things effectively a non-issue through training, his first transformation into a Super Saiyan 2 caused him to become extremely sadistic. While immensely powerful, Super Saiyan transformations drain a lot of energy, and the first was very inefficient before Gohan mastered the state and became a "Full Power Super Saiyan", allowing him to maintain the form effectively indefinitely without issue. While the original Super Saiyan state is eclipsed in power by Super Saiyan 2, the higher forms become increasingly inefficient. Potential Unleashed: The ultimate form that Gohan gains after having his potential unlocked by Old Kai's lengthy ritual, greatly increasing his power by unlocking his extremely high dormant strength. While this state must be maintained by steady, regular training, while Gohan has access to it, he can tap into its power by powering up just as he would to go Super Saiyan. Its power eclipses that of his Super Saiyan forms by a significant margin, and in this state, Gohan is often known as Mystic Gohan or Ultimate Gohan. Gohan has an explosive temper that can flare up suddenly and cause him to act irrationally, but besides this, he is typically a pacifist who avoids fighting and dislikes killing opponents. Due to this, he often keeps his true power restrained so as to avoid harming others. As a Super Saiyan 2 and after first getting his potential unlocked, Gohan was prone to overconfidence, even dipping into sadism during his battle with Cell and seeking to prolong his suffering as retaliation for his crimes. Needs a moon in order to transform and loses control of himself as an Oozaru and as he never trained the weakness away, his tail is a vulnerable point and grabbing or removing it will cause him intense pain. | None Notable (By the ToP he has since lost his Overconfidence and has a handle on his rage) Notable Attacks/Techniques: Ki: The fighting power and life force of a martial artist, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in a number of ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to greatly increase in strength, and it can be fired as blasts of energy or used to create defensive barriers. Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Gohan's incredible power and abilities. Even as a child, Gohan possessed an exceptionally high dormant potential that allows him to show the true depths of his power whenever his rage shows through and grow in strength quickly. Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further and further in power. *Masenko: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both of his hands above his head with his palms facing towards his opponents, he fires a powerful blast of ki. By charging it longer, he can also throw it as an explosive sphere of energy. *Kamehameha: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to finally destroy Cell. *Kiai: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. Saiyan Physiology: The physiology of a Saiyan, an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. One of the most powerful abilities of a Saiyan is their ability to grow stronger and stronger through combat, allowing Gohan to constantly push his own limits during a fight and rise to higher and higher peaks in power. This ability grants a substantial boost in power when Gohan is badly injured, allowing him to reach a whole new level of power once he recovers. *Oozaru: When exposed to the light of the full moon, as long as he still has his tail, Gohan will undergo a transformation into the Oozaru, a massive, gigantic monkey with far greater power. However, this comes at the expense of his skill, turning him into a violent, mindless monster who cannot differentiate between friend and foe. *Super Saiyan: The famous, legendary transformation of a Saiyan that allows them to greatly surpass their limits and reach the fabled state that is Super Saiyan. Gohan achieved this state during his training with his father in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. These transformations can be reached through extensive training, but are more often unlocked in moments of intense emotional turmoil and need, and due to the natural aggressiveness of Saiyans, they cause the user to become more aggressive and malicious, and though Gohan has managed to make these things effectively a non-issue through training, his first transformation into a Super Saiyan 2 caused him to become extremely sadistic. While immensely powerful, Super Saiyan transformations drain a lot of energy, and the first was very inefficient before Gohan mastered the state and became a "Full Power Super Saiyan", allowing him to maintain the form effectively indefinitely without issue. While the original Super Saiyan state is eclipsed in power by Super Saiyan 2, the higher forms become increasingly inefficient. Potential Unleashed: The ultimate form that Gohan gains after having his potential unlocked by Old Kai's lengthy ritual, greatly increasing his power by unlocking his extremely high dormant strength. While this state must be maintained by steady, regular training, while Gohan has access to it, he can tap into its power by powering up just as he would to go Super Saiyan. Its power eclipses that of his Super Saiyan forms by a significant margin, and in this state, Gohan is often known as Mystic Gohan or Ultimate Gohan. Notes: The statement regarding Cell Max, stating if he was complete, he would be unable to be stopped by Broly. Is referring to the mind control that was meant to be implemented in him. As Toriyama notes, without it Cell Max is a brainless

Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Gohan's incredible power and abilities. It can be used in several ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to increase strength immensely. It can be fired as blasts of energy or create defensive barriers. Gohan also had tremendous latent potential that could be unleashed whenever he felt intense anger. Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further in power. *Masenko: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both hands above his head with his palms facing his opponents, he fires a powerful ki blast. He can also throw it as an explosive energy sphere by charging it longer. *Kamehameha: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to destroy Cell for good. *Kiai: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. Saiyan Physiology: The physiology of an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Aside of their immense combat talent, Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. A Saiyan's propensity to get stronger via battle allows Gohan to push his limitations continuously and reach new heights of strength. When Gohan recovers from a severe injury, this trait will significantly increase his power. *Oozaru: When exposed to the light of the full moon, as long as he still has his tail, Gohan will transform the Oozaru, a massive, gigantic monkey with far greater power. However, this comes at the expense of his skill, turning him into a violent, mindless monster who cannot differentiate between friend and foe. *Super Saiyan: The mythical transformation of a Saiyan that enables them to dramatically exceed their limitations and attain the fabled state of a Super Saiyan. Gohan attained this form while practicing in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber with his father. These transformations are possible only after experiencing and regulating great emotional upheaval. They cause the user to become more violent and vicious due to Saiyans' inherent aggression. Though Gohan's human side and training enable him to transcend this nature, his first transformation into a Super Saiyan 2 resulted in him developing a cruel streak due to profoundly intense anger. While super Saiyan transformations are powerful, they use great energy. The first was inefficient until Gohan attained mastery of the condition and became a "Full Power Super Saiyan," enabling him to sustain it passively. Potential Unleashed: Gohan's ultimate form gained after having his final potential unlocked by Old Kai's lengthy ritual. It vastly increases his power by opening his dormant strength. This state surpasses the strength of Super Saiyan 3 Goku from the start of the Majin Buu Saga and even Gotenks. Gohan has an explosive temper that can flare up suddenly and cause him to act irrationally, but he is generally a pacifist who despises fighting. Due to this, he often keeps his true power restrained to avoid harming others. As a Super Saiyan 2 and after first getting his potential unlocked, Gohan was prone to arrogance, even dipping into ruthlessness during his battle with Cell and seeking to prolong his suffering as retaliation for his crimes. He needs a moon to transform and loses control of himself as an Oozaru. He never trained the weakness away; his tail is a vulnerable point and grabbing or removing it will cause him intense pain. Notable Attacks/Techniques: Ki: The martial artist's fighting power and life force, substantial energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Gohan's incredible power and abilities. It can be used in several ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to increase strength immensely. It can be fired as blasts of energy or create defensive barriers. Gohan also had tremendous latent potential that could be unleashed whenever he felt intense anger. Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further in power. *Masenko: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both hands above his head with his palms facing his opponents, he fires a powerful ki blast. He can also throw it as an explosive energy sphere by charging it longer. *Kamehameha: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to destroy Cell for good. *Kiai: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. Saiyan Physiology: The physiology of an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Aside of their immense combat talent, Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. A Saiyan's propensity to get stronger via battle allows Gohan to push his limitations continuously and reach new heights of strength. When Gohan recovers from a severe injury, this trait will significantly increase his power. *Oozaru: When exposed to the light of the full moon, as long as he still has his tail, Gohan will transform the Oozaru, a massive, gigantic monkey with far greater power. However, this comes at the expense of his skill, turning him into a violent, mindless monster who cannot differentiate between friend and foe. *Super Saiyan: The mythical transformation of a Saiyan that enables them to dramatically exceed their limitations and attain the fabled state of a Super Saiyan. Gohan attained this form while practicing in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber with his father. These transformations are possible only after experiencing and regulating great emotional upheaval. They cause the user to become more violent and vicious due to Saiyans' inherent aggression. Though Gohan's human side and training enable him to transcend this nature, his first transformation into a Super Saiyan 2 resulted in him developing a cruel streak due to profoundly intense anger. While super Saiyan transformations are powerful, they use great energy. The first was inefficient until Gohan attained mastery of the condition and became a "Full Power Super Saiyan," enabling him to sustain it passively. Potential Unleashed: Gohan's ultimate form gained after having his final potential unlocked by Old Kai's lengthy ritual. It vastly increases his power by opening his dormant strength. This state surpasses the strength of Super Saiyan 3 Goku from the start of the Majin Buu Saga and even Gotenks. In this form, Gohan is often known as Mystic Gohan or Ultimate Gohan. ==Others== Notable Victories: Notable Losses: Inconclusive Matches: == References == category:Ednaxel2

Gohan has an explosive temper that can flare up suddenly and cause him to act irrationally, but besides this, he is typically a pacifist who avoids fighting and dislikes killing opponents. Due to this, he often keeps his true power restrained so as to avoid harming others. As a Super Saiyan 2 and after first getting his potential unlocked, Gohan was prone to overconfidence, even dipping into sadism during his battle with Cell and seeking to prolong his suffering as retaliation for his crimes. Needs a moon in order to transform and loses control of himself as an Oozaru and as he never trained the weakness away, his tail is a vulnerable point and grabbing or removing it will cause him intense pain. | None Notable (By the ToP he has since lost his Overconfidence and has a handle on his rage) Notable Attacks/Techniques: Ki: The fighting power and life force of a martial artist, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in a number of ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to greatly increase in strength, and it can be fired as blasts of energy or used to create defensive barriers. Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Gohan's incredible power and abilities. Even as a child, Gohan possessed an exceptionally high dormant potential that allows him to show the true depths of his power whenever his rage shows through and grow in strength quickly. Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further and further in power. *Masenko: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both of his hands above his head with his palms facing towards his opponents, he fires a powerful blast of ki. By charging it longer, he can also throw it as an explosive sphere of energy. *Kamehameha: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to finally destroy Cell. *Kiai: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. Saiyan Physiology: The physiology of a Saiyan, an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. One of the most powerful abilities of a Saiyan is their ability to grow stronger and stronger through combat, allowing Gohan to constantly push his own limits during a fight and rise to higher and higher peaks in power. This ability grants a substantial boost in power when Gohan is badly injured, allowing him to reach a whole new level of power once he recovers. *Oozaru: When exposed to the light of the full moon, as long as he still has his tail, Gohan will undergo a transformation into the Oozaru, a massive, gigantic monkey with far greater power. However, this comes at the expense of his skill, turning him into a violent, mindless monster who cannot differentiate between friend and foe. *Super Saiyan: The famous, legendary transformation of a Saiyan that allows them to greatly surpass their limits and reach the fabled state that is Super Saiyan. Gohan achieved this state during his training with his father in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Potential Unleashed: The ultimate form that Gohan gains after having his potential unlocked by Old Kai's lengthy ritual, greatly increasing his power by unlocking his extremely high dormant strength. While this state must be maintained by steady, regular training, while Gohan has access to it, he can tap into its power by powering up just as he would to go Super Saiyan. Its power eclipses that of his Super Saiyan forms by a significant margin, and in this state, Gohan is often known as Mystic Gohan or Ultimate Gohan. Due to this, he often keeps his true power restrained so as to avoid harming others. It can be used in a number of ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to greatly increase in strength, and it can be fired as blasts of energy or used to create defensive barriers. Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Gohan's incredible power and abilities. Even as a child, Gohan possessed an exceptionally high dormant potential that allows him to show the true depths of his power whenever his rage shows through and grow in strength quickly. Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further and further in power. *Masenko: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both of his hands above his head with his palms facing towards his opponents, he fires a powerful blast of ki. By charging it longer, he can also throw it as an explosive sphere of energy. *Kamehameha: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to finally destroy Cell. *Kiai: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. Saiyan Physiology: The physiology of a Saiyan, an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. One of the most powerful abilities of a Saiyan is their ability to grow stronger and stronger through combat, allowing Gohan to constantly push his own limits during a fight and rise to higher and higher peaks in power. This ability grants a substantial boost in power when Gohan is badly injured, allowing him to reach a whole new level of power once he recovers. *Oozaru: When exposed to the light of the full moon, as long as he still has his tail, Gohan will undergo a transformation into the Oozaru, a massive, gigantic monkey with far greater power. However, this comes at the expense of his skill, turning him into a violent, mindless monster who cannot differentiate between friend and foe. *Super Saiyan: The famous, legendary transformation of a Saiyan that allows them to greatly surpass their limits and reach the fabled state that is Super Saiyan. Gohan achieved this state during his training with his father in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. These transformations can be reached through extensive training, but are more often unlocked in moments of intense emotional turmoil and need, and due to the natural aggressiveness of Saiyans, they cause the user to become more aggressive and malicious, and though Gohan has managed to make these things effectively a non-issue through training, his first transformation into a Super Saiyan 2 caused him to become extremely sadistic. While immensely powerful, Super Saiyan transformations drain a lot of energy, and the first was very inefficient before Gohan mastered the state and became a "Full Power Super Saiyan", allowing him to maintain the form effectively indefinitely without issue. While the original Super Saiyan state is eclipsed in power by Super Saiyan 2, the higher forms become increasingly inefficient. Potential Unleashed: The ultimate form that Gohan gains after having his potential unlocked by Old Kai's lengthy ritual, greatly increasing his power by unlocking his extremely high dormant strength. While this state must be maintained by steady, regular training, while Gohan has access to it, he can tap into its power by powering up just as he would to go Super Saiyan. Its power eclipses that of his Super Saiyan forms by a significant margin, and in this state, Gohan is often known as Mystic Gohan or Ultimate Gohan. As Toriyama notes, without it Cell Max is a brainless

Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further and further in power. *Masenko: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both of his hands above his head with his palms facing towards his opponents, he fires a powerful blast of ki. By charging it longer, he can also throw it as an explosive sphere of energy. *Kamehameha: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to finally destroy Cell. *Kiai: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. Saiyan Physiology: The physiology of a Saiyan, an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. One of the most powerful abilities of a Saiyan is their ability to grow stronger and stronger through combat, allowing Gohan to constantly push his own limits during a fight and rise to higher and higher peaks in power. This ability grants a substantial boost in power when Gohan is badly injured, allowing him to reach a whole new level of power once he recovers. *Oozaru: When exposed to the light of the full moon, as long as he still has his tail, Gohan will undergo a transformation into the Oozaru, a massive, gigantic monkey with far greater power. However, this comes at the expense of his skill, turning him into a violent, mindless monster who cannot differentiate between friend and foe. *Super Saiyan: The famous, legendary transformation of a Saiyan that allows them to greatly surpass their limits and reach the fabled state that is Super Saiyan. Gohan achieved this state during his training with his father in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. These transformations can be reached through extensive training, but are more often unlocked in moments of intense emotional turmoil and need, and due to the natural aggressiveness of Saiyans, they cause the user to become more aggressive and malicious, and though Gohan has managed to make these things effectively a non-issue through training, his first transformation into a Super Saiyan 2 caused him to become extremely sadistic. While immensely powerful, Super Saiyan transformations drain a lot of energy, and the first was very inefficient before Gohan mastered the state and became a "Full Power Super Saiyan", allowing him to maintain the form effectively indefinitely without issue. While the original Super Saiyan state is eclipsed in power by Super Saiyan 2, the higher forms become increasingly inefficient. Potential Unleashed: The ultimate form that Gohan gains after having his potential unlocked by Old Kai's lengthy ritual, greatly increasing his power by unlocking his extremely high dormant strength. While this state must be maintained by steady, regular training, while Gohan has access to it, he can tap into its power by powering up just as he would to go Super Saiyan. Its power eclipses that of his Super Saiyan forms by a significant margin, and in this state, Gohan is often known as Mystic Gohan or Ultimate Gohan. Gifted (While Gohan is not as skilled in combat as his father, he is still a highly skilled martial artist and an intelligent tactician. Trained in combat and schooled throughout his entire life since the earliest years of his childhood, Gohan is a clever fighter capable of creatively utilizing his abilities. By using his highly tuned senses and skill alone, he was capable of following Lavender's movements even after being blinded and use his Ki as a radar. As a scholar, tutored throughout his entire life, Gohan is highly intelligent and knowledgeable as well, having an in-depth understanding of the metaphysical mechanics of Ki itself. Due to his intelligence and skill, Goku appointed him as the Captain of Team Universe 7)

Gohan has an explosive temper that can flare up suddenly and cause him to act irrationally, but besides this, he is typically a pacifist who avoids fighting and dislikes killing opponents. Due to this, he often keeps his true power restrained so as to avoid harming others. He had not continued his training and as a result, was not even sure if he could turn into a Super Saiyan in the Resurrection F saga. In Super Hero, Gohan cannot see well in his base form without his glasses, though his transformations fix his eyesight for as long as he uses them. {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" align="center" border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width:100%" | colspan="2" style="text-align: left; " |Notable Attacks/Techniques: |- | |-|Ki Attacks= The fighting power and life force of a martial artist, a tangible energy derived from the user's vigor, courage, and mind. It can be used in a number of ways, such as to surpass the limits of one's body to greatly increase in strength, and it can be fired as blasts of energy or used to create defensive barriers. Along with his Saiyan blood, Ki acts as the source of Gohan's incredible power and abilities. Even as a child, Gohan possessed an exceptionally high dormant potential that allows him to show the true depths of his power whenever his rage shows through and grow in strength quickly. Even after getting his potential unlocked twice, Gohan still had room to grow further and further in power. *{{Nihongo|Kamehameha|かめはめ}}: Goku's signature technique, which Gohan learned from his father during their training in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Gohan's most powerful and famous use of this technique is the Father-Son Kamehameha, utilized alongside his father's spirit to finally destroy Cell. center|250px *{{Nihongo|Masenko||Masenkō}}: Gohan's original signature technique, which he learned from Piccolo. After placing both of his hands above his head with his palms facing towards his opponents, he fires a powerful blast of ki. By charging it longer, he can also throw it as an explosive sphere of energy. GohanAbility1.jpeg Gohanability2.jpeg *{{Nihongo|Kiai|い}}: The ability to project an invisible burst of force with ki, which Gohan can perform with his hands. center|250px *{{Nihongo|Special Beam Cannon||Makankōsappō}}: One of Piccolo's signature attacks Gohan learned in secret. After bringing his index and middle fingers to his forehead, Gohan charges up and fires a spiraling laser that can drill through most opponents. center|250px |-|Saiyan Physiology= The physiology of a Saiyan, an aggressive warrior race of conquerors. Saiyans have the natural ability to control ki and to fly. While his lifespan is comparable to that of a human, Gohan will remain at his peak strength for much longer. One of the most powerful abilities of a Saiyan is their ability to grow stronger and stronger through combat, allowing Gohan to constantly push his own limits during a fight and rise to higher and higher peaks in power. This ability grants a substantial boost in power when Gohan is badly injured, allowing him to reach a whole new level of power once he recovers. {{Nihongo|Super Saiyan|サイヤ|Sūpā Saiyajin}}: The famous, legendary transformation of a Saiyan that allows them to greatly surpass their limits and reach the fabled state that is Super Saiyan. Gohan achieved this state during his training with his father in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. These transformations can be reached through extensive training, but are more often unlocked in moments of intense emotional turmoil and need, and due to the natural aggressiveness of Saiyans, they cause the user to become more aggressive and malicious, and though Gohan has managed to make these things effectively a non-issue through training, his first transformation into a Super Saiyan 2 caused him to become extremely sadistic. While immensely powerful, Super Saiyan transformations drain a lot of energy, and the first was very inefficient before Gohan mastered the state and became a "Full Power Super Saiyan", allowing him to maintain the form effectively indefinitely without issue. While the original Super Saiyan state is eclipsed in power by Super Saiyan 2, the higher forms become increasingly inefficient. GohanSSJ.gif GohanSSJ2.gif |-|Potential Unleashed
